Today, I learn how to make a dashboard using 'flexdashboard' package.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)
library(sf)
library(knitr)
```

## 1. Simulating live satellite thermal anomaly data of last 12 hours

```{r}
set.seed(42)

fire_data <- tibble(
  time = seq(Sys.time() - 43200, Sys.time(), by = "hour"),
  avg_temp_c = runif(13, 30, 42),
  fwi_index = runif(13, 20, 50),
  active_alerts = sample(0:3, 13, replace = TRUE)
)

head(fire_data)
```

## 2. Extracting top current metrics:

```{r}
current_temp <- round(last(fire_data$avg_temp_c), 1)
current_temp

current_fwi <- round(last(fire_data$fwi_index), 1)
current_fwi

total_alerts <- sum(fire_data$active_alerts)
total_alerts
```

Row
-------------------------------------
## 3. Current Regional temp (°C)

```{r}
gauge(current_temp, min = 20, max = 50, symbol = '°', 
      gaugeSectors(
        success = c(20, 32), 
        warning = c(33, 38), 
        danger = c(39, 50)
      ))
```

## 4. Fire Weather Index (FWI)

```{r}
gauge(current_fwi, min = 0, max = 100, 
      gaugeSectors(
        success = c(0, 25), 
        warning = c(26, 45), 
        danger = c(46, 100)
      ))
```

## 5. Active thermal anomalies (Last 12 Hours)

```{r}
valueBox(total_alerts, icon = "fa-fire", 
         color = ifelse(total_alerts > 5, "danger", "warning"))
```
Row
-------------------------------------

## 6. Temperature and FWI Trend

```{r}
plot <- ggplot(fire_data, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_temp_c, color = "Temperature (°C)"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fwi_index, color = "FWI"), linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Temperature (°C)" = "darkred", "FWI" = "darkorange")) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Value", color = "Metric") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(plot)
```

## 7. Detection Log

```{r}
recent_log <- fire_data %>% 
  arrange(desc(time)) %>% 
  select(Time = time, `Temp (°C)` = avg_temp_c, FWI = fwi_index, Alerts = active_alerts) %>% 
  mutate(
    `Temp (°C)` = round(`Temp (°C)`, 1),
    FWI = round(FWI, 1)
  )

kable(recent_log)
```
